prompt: Stage 3-4 carousel, level 7 (you leveled early), 60 HP, 32 gold, you pick sixth. Your board is Elderwood: Ornn, Alistar, Hecarim frontline, Xayah 2-star carrying Guinsoo's Rageblade plus a spare B.F. Sword on the bench. The carousel still shows: Ezreal (Elderwood 4-cost) carrying a Recurve Bow, Ahri carrying a Needlessly Large Rod, Ornn carrying a Spatula. Which do you take?

options.label: Ezreal with the Recurve Bow: a 4-cost in your trait, and the Bow plus your B.F. Sword completes an AD item for Xayah
Ahri with the Rod: the strongest unit on the wheel, pivot to AP later
Ornn with the Spatula: an Elderwood emblem later, plus an Ornn copy

explanation:
Carousel priority is total usable value this round, and Ezreal is the rare pick that scores on every axis: a 4-cost you could not hit at level 7 odds (10% per slot) that slots straight into your Elderwood count, plus a Recurve Bow that combines with the B.F. Sword on your bench into a completed AD item for Xayah before the next fight. That is a unit and an item, both used immediately, on a 2-loss streak at 60 HP where you need to stop the bleeding. Ahri is a stronger unit in a vacuum, but she is AP on a board with AD items and would become a 4-gold sell or a pivot you have no components for.

The Spatula plus Ornn is the seductive one because Elderwood emblems are real. But an emblem needs a second component you do not hold, and this board is not short of Elderwood units; it is short of damage now. Ezreal also gives you a second 4-cost body to hold your future third item.
principle: The best carousel pick is the one you use this round on the line you are already on.
commonMistake: Taking the strongest unit on the wheel regardless of whether it fits, and selling it two rounds later.
